chapters.title: Provisioning and is it right for you?

takeaways: ExpressRoute is a private connection from your network into Microsoft's backbone that bypasses the public internet for predictable latency, high bandwidth and an SLA.
Each circuit has built-in redundant links, but mission-critical workloads should use high or maximum resiliency across peering locations, optionally with a VPN as backup.
Provisioning needs your connectivity provider and can take weeks, so start early and choose ExpressRoute only when performance, predictability or compliance justify the cost over a VPN.
hook: Is Azure ExpressRoute just an expensive VPN? This episode explains for IT and network decision makers how ExpressRoute circuits, peerings and gateways build a private highway into Microsoft's network. You will learn when it is worth the cost, how to plan for resiliency and how long provisioning really takes.
